tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every view and the footer.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Card, modal and game-row surface.

tokens.name: panel2
tokens.usage: Recessed surface inside a card: stat tiles, player rows, segmented control, search inputs, mobile table cards, meter track.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Fill of chips, pills and position badges. Same value as panel2, kept separate in the source.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Table row hover fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: card edges, table rules, input borders, dividers. Decorative only (1.28:1 on panel), so never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and numbers on bg, panel and panel2 (15.3:1 on bg). Also the brand navy.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table headers, captions and inactive segment labels on bg, panel and panel2 (4.89:1 on panel2).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange: primary buttons, active nav tab, active segment, spinner, focus of the brand. White label on it is 3.12:1 — below AA for 13px text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: Interactive blue: links, focus outlines, hover borders on cards and rows, selected search result. Chart series A. 4.55:1 on panel.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Positive state: START, leading categories, live games, good percentile. Text on good-bg is 2.98:1 — fails AA; always pair with a word (先發, 領先).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution state: STREAM/GRAB, injury count, middle percentile. 3.5:1 on panel, 3.17:1 on warn-bg; use bold and a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Negative state: SIT, trailing categories, remove buttons. 3.94:1 on bad-bg; use bold and a word.

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind good text (START badge, category button).

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text (STREAM/GRAB badge).

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind bad text (SIT badge, error banner).

tokens.name: err-text
tokens.usage: Error banner text on bad-bg (5.66:1).

tokens.name: mine
tokens.usage: Row tint marking the user's own players in tables.

tokens.name: navbg
tokens.usage: Header and nav bar ground (top bar on desktop, bottom tab bar on phone); toast ground.

tokens.name: navmut
tokens.usage: Inactive nav labels and header captions on navbg (7.49:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on navbg (header title, hovered nav tab, toast) and the label on accent buttons.

tokens.name: series-b
tokens.usage: Chart series B (the comparison player) in bar and radar comparisons; series A is accent2. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: pct-fair
tokens.usage: Percentile 60–79 step between good and warn on Statcast-style bars. Marks only.

tokens.name: hand-l
tokens.usage: Left-handed pitcher chip text (4.6:1 on chip).

tokens.name: hand-r
tokens.usage: Right-handed pitcher chip text (4.61:1 on chip).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop.

styles.name: score-hero
styles.usage: The H2H weekly score. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: KPI and stat tile value (17px on phone). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: Header title in on-dark; 15px on phone. The word Fantasy takes accent.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heading (h2.sec) above or inside a card.

styles.name: game-score
styles.usage: Score in a compact game row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 加入後，總覽、賽程對戰、傷兵都會以你的球員為中心分析。
styles.usage: Default body copy and nav labels.

styles.name: player-name
styles.usage: Player name in rows, chips and table first cells.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table cells and button labels (buttons at 700).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: 找出今天對到弱打線、最適合 stream 的先發投手。
styles.usage: Helper text under a card's controls, in muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Group label above a list (seclabel) and table group rows, in muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta line under a player or headline, stat tile keys, timestamps.

styles.name: badge
